title: OptinMonster Troubleshooting
description: Fix campaigns not showing, JavaScript conflicts, incorrect targeting rules, and WooCommerce integration issues.

steps.title: Identify Campaign and Display Rule
steps.instructions: Note which campaign should appear (popup, slide-in, inline) and its targeting (URL, referrer, device, logged-in state). Confirm the campaign is Published in the OptinMonster dashboard.

steps.title: Verify WordPress Plugin API Connection
steps.instructions: Reconnect the OptinMonster WordPress plugin to your account. Check for API key errors in OptinMonster → Settings and refresh campaign sync.

steps.title: Confirm Embed Script Loads on Page
steps.instructions: View page source or Network tab for api.optinmonster.com or omappapi scripts. Ad blockers and CSP headers can block the embed — test without extensions.

steps.title: Audit Targeting and Cookie Rules
steps.instructions: Visitors who already converted or dismissed may be cookied out. Test in incognito or clear om* cookies. Verify URL rules match production paths (trailing slashes).

steps.title: Check JavaScript Conflicts
steps.instructions: Console errors from jQuery conflicts, deferred scripts, or minify plugins can stop campaigns. Exclude OptinMonster scripts from Autoptimize/delay-JS rules.

steps.title: Exclude Cached Pages if Needed
steps.instructions: Full-page cache may serve HTML without fresh campaign embeds. Purge cache after campaign changes or exclude pages with inline campaigns from cache.

steps.title: Verify WooCommerce Triggers (If Used)
steps.instructions: Cart abandonment and revenue campaigns need correct WooCommerce connection. Confirm webhooks/cron and that checkout pages are not over-cached.

steps.title: Test Campaign Display End-to-End
steps.instructions: Trigger the campaign on a test URL in incognito. Submit a test opt-in and confirm the integration (Mailchimp, etc.) receives the lead.
